Charming 3-Bedroom Villa in Amaranta, Villanova – Where Every Day Feels Like Home

Step into a home where comfort meets style and every corner is designed for family living. This 3-bedroom villa in Amaranta, part of the vibrant Villanova community in Dubailand, offers the perfect balance of modern convenience and timeless charm.

Inspired by Mediterranean architecture, this thoughtfully designed home features spacious living and dining areas, a separate maid’s room, built-in storage, and a private garage. From cozy mornings in the garden to relaxed evenings with loved ones, this villa is made for creating lasting memories.

Nestled within a serene, family-centric neighborhood, residents of Amaranta enjoy access to lush green parks, walking trails, community pools, playgrounds, and much more. The location offers excellent connectivity , just minutes from the intersection of Al Ain Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, with quick access to schools, shopping, and major landmarks.
